intro.text: A young Torish woman who serves as one of the attendants of the yoki-hijo Yumi.
A young Torish attendant of the yoki-hijo Yumi. The father machine made her a nightmare, yet kept her serving Yumi through the centuries that followed.

items.text: Before joining Yumi's household, Hwanji spent years as an attendant to the yoki-hijo Dwookim, an outspoken voice in the reform movement.
Hwanji grew up in a village in Torio, where scholars from the university in Torio City had once come to help with crop diseases. After Dwookim retired, Hwanji went to serve Yumi under Liyun.
When the father machine was switched on, it turned Hwanji into a nightmare. At its direction she went on attending Yumi through the centuries that followed.
With Chaeyung, Hwanji brought Yumi her breakfast, screened her from onlookers with fans on the way to the cold spring, and washed and dressed her in the ritual order.
The first morning Nikaro woke in Yumi's place, Hwanji and Chaeyung came in with breakfast, sensed something was wrong and fled. When they bathed him at the cold spring, they noticed nothing amiss.
When Nikaro, in Yumi's body, began painting during the hours of prayer, Hwanji was the first person he painted.

As Nikaro grew bolder, Hwanji feared Liyun would blame her. She asked him to make clear it was not her doing, and her account of the reform movement showed that most yoki-hijo lived far freer lives than Yumi.
When Yumi resolved to destroy the scholars' machine, Liyun sent Hwanji to fetch the bailiff, and they gathered villagers to help.
At the scholars' tent, Hwanji and everyone else there began turning into nightmares before Nikaro's eyes.
During the attack on Kilahito, Hwanji was the last of the Torish nightmares that Nikaro painted back into human form.

appearance.text: A short, plump woman who looks to be in her twenties, with a round, very pale face and her hair in a bun.

personality.text: Hwanji likes to hum while she looks after Yumi.
